messages.snippet: Oliver, Attached is our first draft of the share purchase agreement. Key commercial terms as per HoT
messages.subject: Project Quartz — SPA first draft
messages.plaintextBody:
Oliver,

Attached is our first draft of the share purchase agreement. Key commercial terms as per HoT: EV £42.5m; initial cash £35.75m (including £2m retention); £3m deferred; completion accounts with target working capital £4.1m; warranty cap at our opening position of 30% of EV (£12.75m); de minimis £42,500; basket £425,000; claims period 24 months (7 years for tax). Completion targeted 28 March. Grateful for your mark-up.

James
